explication: Token Tracker is a local-first usage and cost tracker for AI coding tools, delivered through a cross-platform CLI, dashboard, and native desktop apps. The main workflow detects tool data, syncs and serves it locally, then presents usage insights in the dashboard. Documented side capabilities include skills browsing, achievements, desktop pets, widgets, and optional cloud features. Source excerpts are partial, so edges without direct excerpt evidence rely on README statements; uncertain internal calls are omitted.
